candidates.sql: SELECT Name, Effectiveness, Manufacturer FROM Medications WHERE Classification = 'Analgesic';

candidates.meaning: List all drugs that are classified as analgesics along with their effects and manufacturers, including any prescriptions that have been issued for these drugs.
candidates.sql: SELECT M.Name, M.Effectiveness, M.Manufacturer, P.Quantity FROM Medications M JOIN Prescriptions P ON M.MedicationID = P.MedicationID WHERE M.Classification = 'Analgesic';

candidates.meaning: List all drugs that are classified as analgesics along with their effects and manufacturers, and also include any related diagnoses and appointments.
candidates.sql: SELECT M.Name, M.Effectiveness, M.Manufacturer, D.Description, A.ReasonForVisit FROM Medications M LEFT JOIN Prescriptions P ON M.MedicationID = P.MedicationID LEFT JOIN Diagnoses D ON P.PatientID = D.PatientID LEFT JOIN Appointments A ON A.PatientID = P.PatientID WHERE M.Classification = 'Analgesic';
